title: MunitionsDepleted
description: A unit spent its last missile, bomb or other non-gun round (CONTRACTS §6; COMBAT CB-11, GAMEPLAY §5): emitted on the shot that empties the non-gun weapons, once per load; guns_only is true when gun rounds remain. A unit that carries no non-gun weapon never emits it. Public view: dropped for a hidden ENEMY unit (FOW-13).
